features.name: instruction_rate_gips
features.definition: Total architectural instructions divided by Sniper global simulated duration.

training_domain.workload_character: Memory-oriented characterization set containing bandwidth, STREAM, and NUMA pointer-chase experiments.

limitations: This model predicts an uncalibrated McPAT CPU-side reference estimate, not physical EPYC 7763 power.
McPAT uses a 22 nm compatibility configuration because McPAT 1.0 does not support the EPYC 7763 7 nm process.
The legacy Sniper DRAM power estimate is excluded from the target.
The model has not been validated on arbitrary compute-intensive HPC applications.
Physical R6525 telemetry calibration is pending.
